named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.restrictedOrder
named_declarations.header: def restrictedOrder (positions : List I) (S : Finset I) (π : Equiv.Perm I) : List I

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.orders
named_declarations.header: def orders (positions : List I) (S : Finset I) : Finset (List I)

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.mem_restrictedOrder
named_declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem mem_restrictedOrder (positions : List I) (S : Finset I)
    (π : Equiv.Perm I) (a : I) :
    a ∈ restrictedOrder positions S π ↔ π a ∈ positions ∧ a ∈ S

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.mem_restrictedOrder_of_complete
named_declarations.header:
theorem mem_restrictedOrder_of_complete (positions : List I)
    (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions) (S : Finset I) (π : Equiv.Perm I) (a : I) :
    a ∈ restrictedOrder positions S π ↔ a ∈ S

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.restrictedOrder_nodup
named_declarations.header:
theorem restrictedOrder_nodup (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup)
    (S : Finset I) (π : Equiv.Perm I) :
    (restrictedOrder positions S π).Nodup

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.restrictedOrder_toFinset
named_declarations.header:
theorem restrictedOrder_toFinset (positions : List I)
    (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions) (S : Finset I) (π : Equiv.Perm I) :
    (restrictedOrder positions S π).toFinset = S

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.restrictedOrder_length
named_declarations.header:
theorem restrictedOrder_length (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup)
    (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions) (S : Finset I) (π : Equiv.Perm I) :
    (restrictedOrder positions S π).length = S.card

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.restrictedOrder_perm
named_declarations.header:
theorem restrictedOrder_perm (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup)
    (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions) (S : Finset I) (π : Equiv.Perm I) :
    (restrictedOrder positions S π).Perm
      (positions.filter (fun a => decide (a ∈ S)))

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.map_restrictedOrder_sublist
named_declarations.header:
theorem map_restrictedOrder_sublist (positions : List I) (S : Finset I)
    (π : Equiv.Perm I) :
    ((restrictedOrder positions S π).map π).Sublist positions

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.filter_restrictedOrder
named_declarations.header:
theorem filter_restrictedOrder (positions : List I) (S T : Finset I)
    (π : Equiv.Perm I) :
    (restrictedOrder positions S π).filter (fun a => decide (a ∈ T)) =
      restrictedOrder positions (S ∩ T) π

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.filter_restrictedOrder_of_subset
named_declarations.header:
theorem filter_restrictedOrder_of_subset (positions : List I) (S T : Finset I)
    (π : Equiv.Perm I) (hTS : T ⊆ S) :
    (restrictedOrder positions S π).filter (fun a => decide (a ∈ T)) =
      restrictedOrder positions T π

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.mem_orders
named_declarations.header:
@[simp] theorem mem_orders (positions : List I) (S : Finset I) (xs : List I) :
    xs ∈ orders positions S ↔
      xs.Perm (positions.filter (fun a => decide (a ∈ S)))

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.orders_nonempty
named_declarations.header:
theorem orders_nonempty (positions : List I) (S : Finset I) :
    (orders positions S).Nonempty

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.restrictedOrder_mem_orders
named_declarations.header:
theorem restrictedOrder_mem_orders (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup)
    (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions) (S : Finset I) (π : Equiv.Perm I) :
    restrictedOrder positions S π ∈ orders positions S

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.orders_card
named_declarations.header:
theorem orders_card (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup)
    (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions) (S : Finset I) :
    (orders positions S).card = Nat.factorial S.card

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.exists_map_eq_of_nodup
Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.exists_relabel_orders
named_declarations.header:
private theorem exists_relabel_orders (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup)
    (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions) (S : Finset I) (xs ys : List I)
    (hxs : xs ∈ orders positions S) (hys : ys ∈ orders positions S) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm I, xs.map σ = ys ∧ ∀ a, σ a ∈ S ↔ a ∈ S

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.restrictedOrder_relabel
named_declarations.header:
private theorem restrictedOrder_relabel (positions : List I) (S : Finset I)
    (π σ : Equiv.Perm I) (hS : ∀ a, σ a ∈ S ↔ a ∈ S) :
    restrictedOrder positions S (π * σ.symm) =
      (restrictedOrder positions S π).map σ

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.fiber_mass_eq
named_declarations.header:
private theorem fiber_mass_eq
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions)
    (S : Finset I) (xs ys : List I)
    (hxs : xs ∈ orders positions S) (hys : ys ∈ orders positions S) :
    uniformOn Set.univ {π | restrictedOrder positions S π = xs} =
      uniformOn Set.univ {π | restrictedOrder positions S π = ys}

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.uniformOn_restrictedOrder_eq
named_declarations.header:
theorem uniformOn_restrictedOrder_eq
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions)
    (S : Finset I) (xs : List I) :
    uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I))
        {π | restrictedOrder positions S π = xs} =
      if xs ∈ orders positions S
      then (Nat.factorial S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹
      else 0

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.PermutationOrder.map_restrictedOrder_uniformOn
named_declarations.header:
theorem map_restrictedOrder_uniformOn
    [MeasurableSpace (Equiv.Perm I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Equiv.Perm I)]
    [MeasurableSpace (List I)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (List I)]
    (positions : List I) (hnd : positions.Nodup) (hcomplete : ∀ a, a ∈ positions)
    (S : Finset I) :
    (uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm I))).map (restrictedOrder positions S) =
      uniformOn (orders positions S : Set (List I))

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.positions
named_declarations.header: def positions : List (Fin 4)

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.selected
named_declarations.header: def selected : Finset (Fin 4)

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.smaller
named_declarations.header: def smaller : Finset (Fin 4)

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.positions_nodup
named_declarations.header: theorem positions_nodup : positions.Nodup

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.positions_complete
named_declarations.header: theorem positions_complete (a : Fin 4) : a ∈ positions

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.law
named_declarations.header: noncomputable def law : Measure (Equiv.Perm (Fin 4))

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.selected_structure
named_declarations.header:
theorem selected_structure (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) :
    (restrictedOrder positions selected π).Nodup ∧
      (restrictedOrder positions selected π).toFinset = selected ∧
      (restrictedOrder positions selected π).length = 3 ∧
      ((restrictedOrder positions selected π).map π).Sublist positions

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.selected_permutation
named_declarations.header:
theorem selected_permutation (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) :
    (restrictedOrder positions selected π).Perm [0, 2, 3]

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.selected_orders_card
named_declarations.header: theorem selected_orders_card : (orders positions selected).card = 6

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.fiber_mass_of_mem
named_declarations.header:
private theorem fiber_mass_of_mem (S : Finset (Fin 4)) (xs : List (Fin 4))
    (hxs : xs ∈ orders positions S) :
    law {π | restrictedOrder positions S π = xs} =
      (Nat.factorial S.card : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.order_023_mass
named_declarations.header:
theorem order_023_mass :
    law {π | restrictedOrder positions selected π = [0, 2, 3]} = 1 / 6

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.observed_law
named_declarations.header:
theorem observed_law :
    law.map (restrictedOrder positions selected) =
      uniformOn (orders positions selected : Set (List (Fin 4)))

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.order_032_mass_via_map
named_declarations.header:
theorem order_032_mass_via_map :
    law {π | restrictedOrder positions selected π = [0, 3, 2]} = 1 / 6

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.repeated_order_mass_zero
named_declarations.header:
theorem repeated_order_mass_zero :
    law {π | restrictedOrder positions selected π = [0, 0, 2]} = 0

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.nestedObservation
named_declarations.header: def nestedObservation (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) : List (Fin 4)

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.nestedObservation_eq
named_declarations.header:
theorem nestedObservation_eq (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) :
    nestedObservation π = restrictedOrder positions smaller π

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.nested_order_30_mass
named_declarations.header:
theorem nested_order_30_mass :
    law {π | nestedObservation π = [3, 0]} = 1 / 2

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.singleton_order_mass
named_declarations.header:
theorem singleton_order_mass :
    law {π | restrictedOrder positions {2} π = [2]} = 1

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrder.full_order_mass
named_declarations.header:
theorem full_order_mass :
    law {π | restrictedOrder positions Finset.univ π = [3, 1, 0, 2]} = 1 / 24

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.empty_subset_output
named_declarations.header:
theorem empty_subset_output (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    restrictedOrder [0, 1, 2] ∅ π = []

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.empty_subset_orders
named_declarations.header:
theorem empty_subset_orders :
    orders ([0, 1, 2] : List (Fin 3)) ∅ = {[]}

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.empty_subset_mass
named_declarations.header:
theorem empty_subset_mass :
    uniformOn Set.univ
      {π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3) | restrictedOrder [0, 1, 2] ∅ π = []} = 1

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.empty_index_mass
named_declarations.header:
theorem empty_index_mass :
    uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (Equiv.Perm Empty))
      {π | restrictedOrder ([] : List Empty) ∅ π = []} = 1

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.cycle
named_declarations.header: def cycle : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.cycle_values
named_declarations.header: theorem cycle_values : cycle 0 = 1 ∧ cycle 1 = 2 ∧ cycle 2 = 0

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.cycle_inverse_order
named_declarations.header:
theorem cycle_inverse_order :
    ([0, 1, 2] : List (Fin 3)).map cycle.symm = [2, 0, 1]

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.cycle_restricted_order
named_declarations.header:
theorem cycle_restricted_order :
    restrictedOrder ([0, 1, 2] : List (Fin 3)) {0, 1} cycle = [0, 1]

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.cycle_direct_order
named_declarations.header:
theorem cycle_direct_order :
    (([0, 1, 2] : List (Fin 3)).map cycle).filter
      (fun a => decide (a ∈ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 3)))) = [1, 0]

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.inverse_and_direct_orders_differ
named_declarations.header:
theorem inverse_and_direct_orders_differ :
    restrictedOrder ([0, 1, 2] : List (Fin 3)) {0, 1} cycle ≠
      (([0, 1, 2] : List (Fin 3)).map cycle).filter
        (fun a => decide (a ∈ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 3))))

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.numeric_enumeration_values
named_declarations.header:
theorem numeric_enumeration_values :
    (restrictedOrder ([0, 2, 1] : List (Fin 3)) Finset.univ
      (Equiv.refl (Fin 3))).map spacedPriority = [-7, 4, 100]

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.numeric_enumeration_increasing
named_declarations.header:
theorem numeric_enumeration_increasing :
    List.Pairwise (fun a b : Int => a < b)
      ((restrictedOrder ([0, 2, 1] : List (Fin 3)) Finset.univ
        (Equiv.refl (Fin 3))).map spacedPriority)

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.ordinary_enumeration_not_increasing
named_declarations.header:
theorem ordinary_enumeration_not_increasing :
    ¬ List.Pairwise (fun a b : Int => a < b)
      ((restrictedOrder ([0, 1, 2] : List (Fin 3)) Finset.univ
        (Equiv.refl (Fin 3))).map spacedPriority)

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.numeric_and_ordinary_orders_differ
named_declarations.header:
theorem numeric_and_ordinary_orders_differ :
    restrictedOrder ([0, 2, 1] : List (Fin 3)) Finset.univ (Equiv.refl (Fin 3)) ≠
      restrictedOrder ([0, 1, 2] : List (Fin 3)) Finset.univ (Equiv.refl (Fin 3))

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.incomplete_output
named_declarations.header:
theorem incomplete_output :
    restrictedOrder ([0] : List (Fin 2)) {0} (Equiv.swap 0 1) = []

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.incomplete_support_counterexample
named_declarations.header:
theorem incomplete_support_counterexample :
    ([0] : List (Fin 2)).Nodup ∧
      restrictedOrder ([0] : List (Fin 2)) {0} (Equiv.swap 0 1) ∉
        orders ([0] : List (Fin 2)) {0}

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.repeated_output
named_declarations.header:
theorem repeated_output :
    restrictedOrder ([0, 0, 1] : List (Fin 2)) Finset.univ (Equiv.swap 0 1) =
      [1, 1, 0]

named_declarations.name: Examples.PermutationOrderBoundary.repeated_support_counterexample
named_declarations.header:
theorem repeated_support_counterexample :
    (∀ a : Fin 2, a ∈ ([0, 0, 1] : List (Fin 2))) ∧
      restrictedOrder ([0, 0, 1] : List (Fin 2)) Finset.univ (Equiv.swap 0 1) ∉
        orders ([0, 0, 1] : List (Fin 2)) Finset.univ
